newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville reduces power price offer for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville reduces power price offer for Tuesday.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) said it was offering up to 300 megawatts of peak power for Tuesday delivery at $20.75 per megawatt hour (MWh), a sharp drop from offers for Monday delivery.
Peak power in the Northwest and the California Oregon Border (COB) for Tuesday delivery was being offered at $21.00 per MWh, the federal agency said Monday.
Peak power for Monday delivery had been offered last week at $31.50 per MWh, and at $32.00 in the Northwest and $32.75 at COB.
